entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please have your order number ready. All calls may be recorded for quality assurance.
Just get me to a person. Agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF-881-6234.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Pulling up VF-881-6234 now... I see the ProFit Jersey. To get this started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's way too tight.
I understand. So the fit isn't right on the jersey. I just need to verify the purchase date to check the return eligibility. One moment.
Look, is it a yes or a no? I don't have all day.
It's a yes. I see here it was delivered 85 days ago, and our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within the window.
Okay, good. So what's next? Do you want me to do an exchange or just send it back?
We can do either. I can process a return for a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for a larger size if you'd like.
Just the refund. Send me the label.

Absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next five minutes. Just print that out, and you can drop the package off at any carrier location.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
